title: A robust protocol for the generation of human midbrain organoids
author: Zagare, Gobin, et al.
materials: Timing: 1 h6.Autoclave scissors and forceps for Day 5, which are needed to prepare the embedding materials (step 10) and at the embedding stage (step 11 and 12).7.Sterilize a horizontal shaker before placing it in an incubator as detailed in step 15.

steps.title: Set up sterile workspace and incubator
steps.instruction: Perform all subsequent steps inside a Class II biosafety cabinet and keep cells at 37 °C with 5 % CO₂ in a humidified incubator.

substeps.instruction: Work inside a Class II biosafety cabinet.

steps.title: Prepare N2B27 base medium
steps.instruction: Within 20–30 min, prepare N2B27 base medium according to the recipe in the Materials and Equipment section; store at 4 °C for up to one month and add small‑molecule supplements fresh on the day of media change.

steps.title: Autoclave scissors and forceps
steps.instruction: Autoclave scissors and forceps (required for Day 5 embedding) for 1 h.

steps.title: Sterilize horizontal shaker
steps.instruction: Sterilize a horizontal shaker for 1 h before placing it in the incubator as described for step 15.

steps.title: Prepare embedding materials (parafilm and matrix)
steps.instruction: One day before embedding (Day 5), prepare parafilm dimple trays and thaw extracellular matrix as follows:

substeps.instruction: Cut six Parafilm squares ≈5 × 5 cm (enough for one 96‑well plate), spray each with 70 % ethanol, and place under the biosafety cabinet.
Remove the Parafilm from the backing paper and allow the ethanol to evaporate.
Using sterile forceps, lay one Parafilm square over an empty tip tray (e.g., 200 µL or 1000 µL tip box without lid).
Create a 4 × 4 array of small dimples on the Parafilm by pressing a gloved finger over each hole.
Spray the dimpled Parafilm with 70 % ethanol again, then place it in a sterile 10 cm Petri dish to allow complete evaporation of ethanol.
Once dry, close the Petri dish and seal it with Parafilm; store until the embedding step (step 12).
Place the Geltrex stock vial on ice at 4 °C in the refrigerator and let it thaw overnight (8–14 h).
